additional_implementation_for_other_phys.reason: The current P7 closure evolves thermal recipients. Nonthermal spectra can be imported and checked at P8, but a selected model still needs its full momentum-dependent coupled kinetic operator.
Native thermal small-network adapters reject these terms until a concrete cascade/network kernel is supplied and implemented.

The native CLASS branch has a checked free-streaming-radiation matching domain. Other equations require a pinned implementation; P9 accepts its computed spectra with provenance but does not derive those equations.
Homogeneous phase survival gives volume fraction, not a unique pocket-radius distribution. A geometry closure must be specified and verified before using pocket surfaces as dynamical sources.
The native pointwise generator computes thermal rates in an explicit domain. Nonthermal spectra require independently computed bound weak-rate tables; arbitrary spectra are not silently thermalized.

completion_rule: A passing numerical test, conditional benchmark or a green CI result is not completion of the full physical R135 project. Missing inputs and unsupported models remain explicit.
